cases.sentence: ___ скажут из мира мертвых о Египте и его помощниках: «Они спустились и лежат с необрезанными, с теми, кто пал от меча».
cases.explain: «Могучие вожди» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The strong among the mighty will speak to him out of the middle of Sheol  with those who help him. They have gone down. The uncircumcised lie still, slain by the sword.

cases.sentence: Те, кто сеял страх на земле живых, сошли необрезанными в ___.
cases.explain: «нижний мир» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: “There is Elam and all her multitude around her grave; all of them slain, fallen by the sword, who have gone down uncircumcised into the lower parts of the earth, who caused their terror in the land of the living, and have borne their shame with those who go down to the pit.

cases.sentence: Не лежат они с ___ древности , которые сошли в мир мертвых с оружием, чьи мечи положены им под голову, чьи беззакония покоятся на их костях.
cases.explain: «павшими воинами» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: They will not lie with the mighty who are fallen of the uncircumcised, who have gone down to Sheol with their weapons of war, and have laid their swords under their heads, and their iniquities are on their bones; for they were the terror of the mighty in the land of the living.
